body:
Tried fluorophenibut at 125mg took it at 6pm and did not really feel much of anything before going to bed, but I woke up feeling super relaxed.
Seemed to last the whole next day. Seems like its very slow to take effect and a long time to leave my system. I react badly to benzodiazepines because I abused them when I was younger and now I get rebound anger and agitation within a few hours of taking them.
It's nice to find an effective anti-anxiety medicine that does not cause me problems.
